# rustinion_report_schedule (Resource)

Manages a scheduled report emailed to a list of recipients (Reports in the admin UI): an uptime summary, SLO report or incident digest, daily, weekly or monthly.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cadence` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.
- `name` (String)
- `recipients` (List of String) Email addresses, at least one.
- `report_type` (String) `uptime_summary`, `slo_report` or `incident_digest`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `format` (String) `html` (default, in the email body) or `csv` (attached).
- `group_id` (String) Limit the report to one group; omit for the whole organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_sent_at` (String) When the report last went out (RFC3339), null before the first send.
